encoding: All fields ending _b64 contain standard base64 of original UTF-8 source text. Decode only for source auditing. Labels are neutral aliases, never renamed source paths.

nodes.label: principle build the lever

nodes.label: principle make operations idempotent

nodes.label: principle test behavior not implementation
nodes.purpose_trigger: Choose assertions about observable behavior rather than internal arrangement.

nodes.label: principle explain the number
nodes.purpose_trigger: Identify what a measurement captures and what limits it before trusting the result.

nodes.label: principle never block on the human

nodes.label: principle redesign from first principles
nodes.purpose_trigger: Reconsider an existing design as if a new requirement had been present initially.

nodes.label: principle minimize reader load
nodes.purpose_trigger: Reduce indirection and hidden state when code is difficult to follow.

nodes.label: principle exhaust the design space
nodes.purpose_trigger: Compare distinct prototypes for unfamiliar interaction or architectural choices.

nodes.label: principle migrate callers then delete legacy apis

nodes.label: principle attack the premise
nodes.purpose_trigger: Test a shared assumption after repeated fixes fail the same gate.

nodes.label: principle laziness protocol
nodes.purpose_trigger: Prefer deletion and the smallest adequate change when considering abstractions or refactors.

nodes.label: principle experience first
nodes.purpose_trigger: Prioritize the user experience when product scope and implementation convenience compete.

nodes.label: principle prove it works
nodes.purpose_trigger: Inspect and exercise the real result before declaring work complete.

nodes.label: principle separate before serializing shared state
nodes.purpose_trigger: Eliminate unnecessary shared writes before introducing synchronization.

nodes.label: principle type system discipline
nodes.purpose_trigger: Represent domain distinctions and invalid states in types; parse external data at boundaries.
